verses.spanda_span-p01_1: By whose opening and closing the worlds dissolve and emerge — to him, source of power-wheel glory, I praise Śaṅkara.
verses.spanda_span-p01_2: Where this whole effect abides, and whence it has come forth — from being uncovered in form, there is no obstruction anywhere.
verses.spanda_span-p01_3: Even in the difference of waking and the rest, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.
verses.spanda_span-p01_4: I happy, suffering, attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
verses.spanda_span-p01_5: Where there is no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, and not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately.
verses.spanda_span-p01_6: Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.
verses.spanda_span-p02_7: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
verses.spanda_span-p02_8: Not as impelled by wish-impulsion does it proceed; but, but — from self-power's touch the person becomes like that.
verses.spanda_span-p02_9: Incapable of own purity, desiring things to be done — when agitation dissolves, then may there be the supreme state.
verses.spanda_span-p02_10: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing and doing; whatever he desires, he knows and does.
verses.spanda_span-p02_11: Regarding own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence his evil course?
verses.spanda_span-p02_12: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.
verses.spanda_span-p02_13: Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not thus being-remembered does that reality attain.
verses.spanda_span-p03_14: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.
verses.spanda_span-p03_15: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
verses.spanda_span-p03_16: But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever, from not perceiving other.
verses.spanda_span-p03_17: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may it be of the fully awake — at beginning and end, but of the other.
verses.spanda_span-p03_18: Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power: in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.
verses.spanda_span-p03_19: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
verses.spanda_span-p04_20: Of unawakened minds, eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.
verses.spanda_span-p04_21: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, the own state soon attains.
verses.spanda_span-p04_22: Angry, thrilled, or what shall I do — or pondering, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.
verses.spanda_span-p04_23: Which state seized, whatever this one tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.
verses.spanda_span-p04_24: Her, by resorting to the upper path, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range left.
verses.spanda_span-p04_25: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
